topic.title: Preview invoices against a stubbed API

body.p: Stub the invoices endpoint so that every GET request returns the invoices in invoices.json.
Stub invoice creation too, so that a POST request returns a new invoice ID.
Stub the notices endpoint with one billing notice.

data.name: doc-detective
data.value: step {"mockRequest":{"url":"**/api/notices","response":{"body":["Invoices are due on the 3rd of each month."]}}}

body.p: Stub the status endpoint so that it reports OK.
Open the test site at http://localhost:8092/.
In the browser console, fetch /api/invoices?page=1. The response lists invoice inv-1.
Send a POST request to /api/invoices. The response status is 201, and the body is the new ID, inv-2.

data.name: doc-detective
data.value: step {"runBrowserScript":{"script":"return fetch('/api/invoices', { method: 'POST' }).then(async (r) => r.status + ' ' + (await r.json()).id);","output":"201 inv-2"}}

body.p: Fetch /api/notices. The notice says when invoices are due, and matches the copy saved in output/notices.json.
Fetch /api/status. The response is the text OK.
Check the page title by evaluating document.title in the console.
